card.name: Inside long medical and foreign words
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of a longer word, such as the 're' in adrenergic, 'xi' in anxiolytics, 'radi' in radiopaque or 'å' in Swedish tvåtusentalet. It fires where the word is still unfinished.

modes.label: Drug-class words
modes.description: Early pieces of drug-class terms like adrenergic and anxiolytics in interaction lists.

modes.label: Radio- words
modes.description: The start of radiopaque or radiographic.
modes.example: the histrelin implant is not<< radi>>opaque

modes.label: Foreign words
modes.description: Pieces inside non-English words quoted in English text.

card.writes: Suppresses 'att'-type continuations, so it steers the word away from those endings; the promoted tokens show no clear shared theme.
